entries.text: Fixed QuestDB queries using BETWEEN on DOUBLE, DECIMAL or VARCHAR operands failing with "there is no matching operator `between` with the argument type: DOUBLE" (TPC-H Q6, TPC-DS 13/28/37/40/48/58/82/85, DataVault, TPC-DI, Read Primitives); the adapter now rewrites BETWEEN and NOT BETWEEN into equivalent range comparisons.
